  [gradient-evolve] {

    background-image: linear-gradient(255deg, #facb0e, #f06ba8 30%, #78bae6 65%, #fff);
  }

  /* Pseudo element with final gradient */
  [gradient-evolve]::before {
    content: '';
    position: absolute;
    top: 0;
    right: 0;
    bottom: 0;
    left: 0;
    /* Final gradient */
    background-image: linear-gradient(255deg, #f06ba8, #facb0e 30%, #78bae6 65%, #fff);

<script>
  (function () {
    var ua = navigator.userAgent;
    var vendor = navigator.vendor || "";

    // iPadOS 13+ pretends to be macOS, so fall back to touch-point sniffing.
    var isIOS =
      /iP(hone|od|ad)/.test(ua) ||
      (/Mac/.test(ua) && navigator.maxTouchPoints > 1);

    // Real Safari: Apple vendor + "Safari", but none of the other engines' tokens.
    var isSafari =
      /Apple/.test(vendor) &&
      /Safari/.test(ua) &&
      !/Chrome|Chromium|CriOS|FxiOS|EdgiOS|Edg\/|OPR\/|Android/.test(ua);

    // Every iOS browser is WebKit under the hood, so WebKit-only bugs
    // (mix-blend-mode, etc.) hit ALL iOS browsers — treat iOS as Safari-like.
    var html = document.documentElement;
    if (isSafari || isIOS) html.classList.add("is--safari");
    if (isIOS) html.classList.add("is--ios");
  })();

  [line-clamp] {

  }
